defects.observed: No arrowheads are visible anywhere in the diagram. Pixel-scanning t0.png along the connector row (y=421) shows the connector stroke (#4a5d8a) running from x=320 and terminating abruptly at x=400, the left border of the next stage card; every pixel from x=402 to x=458 is background. The arrowhead marker is defined and referenced (marker id="arrowhead", marker-end on each <line x1=240 x2=378>) but the marker tip lands at SVG x=378 while the next stage rect starts at SVG x=320, and the opaque stage rects (fill #141d33) are painted later in document order, so they cover the last ~58px of each connector plus the entire arrowhead. Viewer sees three plain dashed line stubs, not arrows.
defects.required: Prompt: 4 stages 'connected by arrows'. Arrowheads must be visible on each connector.

defects.observed: The pulse does not travel along the visible connectors. Its motion path is 'M 140,240 L 400,240 L 660,240 L 920,240', a straight line through the interiors of all four stage cards. In all three sampled frames the dot is inside a stage box, never on a connector: t0 dot center ~(288,421) inside the Build card (screen x 140-320); t2 ~(703,421) inside the Deploy card (660-840); t5 ~(535,421) inside the Test card (400-580). The path also runs at the icon's vertical band (SVG y=240 vs icon circles cy=222 r=26), so the dot visibly passes over/through each stage icon rather than between the stages.
defects.required: Prompt: 'a pulse/dot animating along the path from stage to stage'. Rubric: pulse must lie ON the connecting path.

defects.observed: Stage sub-labels ('compile & package', 'unit & integration', 'release to prod', 'observe & alert') render at 15px (.stage-sub font-size: 15px, SVG scale 1:1), well under the presentation legibility floor.
defects.required: Rubric item 4: body text >= ~20px equivalent for a presentation.

defects.observed: The motion path start/end (SVG x=140 and x=920) do not coincide with the first and last stage centers (x=150 and x=930), so the pulse begins 10px left of Build's center and stops 10px short of Monitor's center before jumping back to the start.
defects.required: Pulse should travel from stage to stage, i.e. between the stage anchor points.

defects.observed: The diagram occupies only a ~140px-tall band in the middle of the 1280x720 canvas, leaving a ~220px empty gap between the subtitle and the first card and a comparable dead band below; the SVG canvas is 480 tall but content ends at y~330.
defects.required: Rubric item 2: layout should make reasonable use of the requested arrangement/viewport.

summary: Four correctly labeled stages, no overflow (1280x720), no console errors, and the pulse genuinely animates and loops (t0 Build, t2 Deploy, t5 Test with matching stage glow, 4s cycle). But two substantive defects: the connectors have no visible arrowheads at all (markers are painted over by the opaque stage rects), and the pulse's motion path runs straight through the interiors of the stage cards rather than along the visible connectors, so in every sampled frame the dot sits inside a card next to its icon. Plus 15px sub-labels and a lot of dead vertical space.
